blocks.text: MARAWI CITY — The Army’s 101st Infantry Brigade on Saturday rendered a 21-gun salute on Saturday for 168 soldiers and police officers who perished in the five-month battle nine years ago that concluded in the flushing out from this besieged city of Islamic State-linked militants. That is why Oct. 17 is observed as “Marawi Liberation Day” since 2017 to mark the momentous day. On Saturday, Presidential Adviser for Marawi Rehabilitation and Development Nasser Pangandaman led the wreath-laying rites at the Tears from Heaven monument inside Campo Ranao, witnessed by officials from the Coast Guard, Philippine National Police, Bureau of Fire Protection, […]...
